description: Opens Microsoft Access .mdb and .accdb files from chat links as tables, with no Access, Java, ODBC or Windows. Agents in the thread can list the tables of the open database and run read-only queries on it, so their answers come from the file. Shows each column with its Access type, saved queries with their SQL, and the relationships as an ER diagram. Files from Access 97 to Microsoft 365 are read in the panel and never uploaded. Exporting the diagram, or more than 10,000 rows of a result, needs DBConvert PRO ($9 a month).
